It would’ve been 5 stars but…
I had an appointment time block of 2pm-4pm which was discussed and confirmed the evening before. He (I don’t know the gentleman’s name because he didn’t speak ANY English at all, nor did he attempt to introduce himself) arrived at 9:30ish AM waking me from sleep. I inquired about an earlier (intended for early afternoon) time so I could prepare to be awake but was denied so I was up late the night before, thinking I had no early appointments for the next day.
After banging on my door and waking me up UNEXPECTEDLY, I learned that he was very nice and although we had to communicate through cellphone translator app, my mini schnauzer mix and I were very pleased with the results.
